summary: Each column on the Access page has its own filter, so you can narrow a long list and still drag and drop. Access packages can be filtered too.

new.title: Filter each column on the Access page
new.text: Type in a column's filter box to narrow only that column. The other columns stay, so you can drag a person onto the role you found. Type package to find access packages.

new.title: Filter access packages
new.text: A filter box above the access packages list narrows it by package name, description or group name.

fixes.title: Simpler Access page
fixes.text: The workload check button is removed. Each workload role shows its own status: in place, missing or left out.
